reasons.claim: The chain is Muhammad b. Qays from Abu Ja'far, whose words relay the account; the Commander of the Faithful's judgment is the content of the saying, not a link.
reasons.quote: رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ

reasons.claim: Two co-transmitters joined by «جميعا» each reach the Imam, giving two routes.
reasons.quote: رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ وَ اَلْحَلَبِيُّ جَمِيعاً عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ

reasons.claim: Ibn Faddal, Yunus b. Ya'qub, an unnamed hearer, then the Imam he heard speaking.
reasons.quote: عَنِ اِبْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ عَمَّنْ سَمِعَ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ

reviews.question: a source known only by a title («العبد الصالح»); the structure is the same either way

reasons.claim: Musa b. Bakr transmits from the one titled «العبد الصالح», who answers; the title is written as the last link.
reasons.quote: رَوَى مُوسَى بْنُ بَكْرٍ عَنِ اَلْعَبْدِ اَلصَّالِحِ

reasons.claim: Six transmitters in order, the compiler's unnamed father first and Muhammad b. Abd Allah's father last.
reasons.quote: عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ

reasons.claim: «أخيه» qualifies Ahmad b. Hammad and is one link with him.
The asker Isma'il b. Muslim is a link, then the Imam he asked who answers (ruling 3).
reasons.quote: رُوِيَ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ اَلصَّادِقَ

reasons.claim: The narrator addresses al-Rida, who answers and is the last link; «أمرني أبي» is inside the answer.
A single route of three links ending at the Imam who speaks.
reasons.quote: رَوَى عَبْدُ اَللَّهِ بْنُ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ

reasons.claim: The chain runs through al-Rida, his forefathers, and Ali, ending at the Prophet who is not a link.
The first links are the compiler's father, Sa'd, Muhammad b. al-Husayn and Ali b. Asbat.
reasons.quote: عَنْ عَلِىِّ بْنِ أَسْباط قالَ سَمِعْتُ عَلِىِّ بْنِ مُوسَى الرِّضا

reviews.uncertainty_note: Reader B's last-link occurrence points into «عَلَيْهِ» rather than «عَلِيِ»; the names are the same, A's placement is the right one.

reasons.claim: The report is a bare saying with no transmitter written.
reasons.quote: شَرُّ اَلْمَآكِلِ أَكْلُ مَالِ اَلْيَتِيمِ ظُلْماً
